description: Hostnames of Tixati Software (tixati.com, fopnu.com, darkmx.app, supersimpleserver.com) and of the WinMX community (winmxconex.com, winmxworld.com): DNS, certificate transparency names and redirects. See README.md for how it was collected.

fields.ct.listed: name appears in crt.sh certificate transparency logs
fields.ct.latest_not_after: latest expiry seen in crt.sh; crt.sh can lag behind renewals, see README.md
fields.http_root: redirect chain for http://<host>/, one request per hop
fields.https_root: responses to https://<host>/ with counts; hosts with two A records were sampled 12 times, others 3 times
fields.https_unknown_path: responses to https://<host>/zz/test.zip?q=1, shows whether a redirect keeps the path
